combo_label: Breakfast × Herbs & Spices × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: Feathery frond laid over cured salmon, and the flavour in a jar of gherkins
Soft white pig fat, once the standard grease for a hot cooking pan
Firm browned edge of a slice, trimmed away for a fussy child
Tiered stand of little jars by the cooker, each holding a different powder or leaf
Hard silcrete boulder from West Woods near Marlborough, dressed into the outer ring
Cross-shaped setting of gneiss slabs standing on the Isle of Lewis
Twist-topped mill on the table that crushes whole peppercorns over a dish
One plant gives both a warm citrus seed and a fresh leaf that tastes of soap to some
Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
Hung over smouldering oak until a split, brined herring is ready to grill
Thin hollow onion-family leaves snipped over a jacket potato, with mauve pompom flowers
